q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of project management experience within a design practice

Strong client-facing experience, preferably within a consultancy, engineering, or project delivery environment.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
